output_list.criticism: The function does not check the return value of the transfer function, which can be exploited by a malicious contract to reenter the function and claim rewards multiple times.
The function does not check the return value of the burn function, which can be exploited by a malicious contract to reenter the function and burn tokens multiple times.
The function does not check the return value of the sellToken function, which can be exploited by a malicious contract to reenter the function and sell tokens multiple times.
